decisions.reason: The premium raisin stollen won gold from the Deutsches Brotinstitut in both 2023 and 2024 and is presented as a flagship, so its results clearly exceed the aspiration level and give management no reason to search for alternatives.

The dark barley malt rye bread is the only one of the four 2023 bread launches still featured on its own page, which suggests it passed the firm's earlier problemistic pruning, and as a low-cost extension of established know-how it can be carried with modest slack.

The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line in the firm's core seasonal gift business and has kept its own page across both years, so there is no evident shortfall prompting a drop.
